events.event_name: Jung Saem Mool × Van Leeuwen Mobile Pop-Up
events.brand: Jung Saem Mool Beauty × Van Leeuwen
events.address: Lexington Avenue; 557 Broadway; 21–27 9th Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A two-day mobile beauty-and-ice-cream activation celebrating Jung Saem Mool Beauty's Sephora launch, moving between Manhattan stops near Sephora locations.
events.what_is_free: A special Jung Saem Mool × Van Leeuwen ice cream is available to guests who follow @jsmbeauty_global; a social-post promotion offers a chance at a full-size Metal Lip Serum, limited to 200 units per day.
events.caveats: Open to the public. Free ice cream requires following @jsmbeauty_global. The full-size lip-serum social giveaway is limited to 200 units per day and is not guaranteed.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19: 11 AM–1 PM Lexington Avenue; 1:30–3:30 PM at 557 Broadway; 4–7 PM at 21–27 9th Avenue. Sept. 20 follows the same first two stops, then 4–6 PM at 21–27 9th Avenue.

events.address: 406A Comfort Road, Governors Island, New York, NY 10004
events.what_it_is: A Climate Week NYC public festival of eco-inspired performances, installations, workshops and interactive activities at the Climate Imaginarium.
events.what_is_free: Festival admission, performances, visual art, workshops and interactive programming are free.
events.caveats: Official Climate Week NYC listing identifies this as a public event. Tickets are free and reservations are recommended, not stated as mandatory.
events.practical_notes: Interactive activities, workshops and visual art run 11 AM–4 PM. Performances run approximately 12:45–2:45 PM.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary × SUKOSHI Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A three-day Japanese-wellness-inspired pop-up with tongue readings, tincture sampling, ingredient education and kakigori shaved ice.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 guests each day receive a mini Apothékary tincture; tincture samples and kakigori are offered while supplies last.
events.caveats: Freebies are limited: mini tincture is for the first 50 guests each day and kakigori is while supplies last. A separate 20% event discount and gift-with-purchase are purchase-dependent.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18 is 1–9 PM; Saturday and Sunday Sept. 19–20 are 9 AM–9 PM. Eventbrite lists free tickets from organizer Apothékary.

events.what_it_is: Credo Beauty's SoHo grand-opening weekend with complimentary gifts for early visitors, product raffles and an event-only gift with purchase.
events.what_is_free: The first 150 guests each day receive a complimentary gift with no purchase necessary; onsite product raffles also require no purchase.
events.caveats: RSVP is explicitly not required and does not guarantee gift eligibility. Complimentary gifts are first-come, first-served and limited to the first 150 guests each day. The separate $100+ gift-with-purchase requires a purchase.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19: 11 AM–7 PM. Sept. 20: 11 AM–6 PM. Arrive early for the no-purchase gift.
